import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    invoices = inputs["invoices"].copy()
    
    # Initialize reason_codes column as empty strings
    reason_codes = [""] * len(invoices)
    
    # R1: amount IS NULL OR amount < 0 -> 'AMT_BAD'
    r1_fail = invoices["amount"].isna() | (invoices["amount"] < 0)
    reason_codes = [
        (codes + "|AMT_BAD" if codes else "AMT_BAD") if fail else codes
        for codes, fail in zip(reason_codes, r1_fail)
    ]
    
    # R2: tax IS NULL OR tax < 0 -> 'TAX_BAD'
    r2_fail = invoices["tax"].isna() | (invoices["tax"] < 0)
    reason_codes = [
        (codes + "|TAX_BAD" if codes else "TAX_BAD") if fail else codes
        for codes, fail in zip(reason_codes, r2_fail)
    ]
    
    # R3: tax > amount * 0.5 -> 'TAX_EXCESS'
    # NULL-safe: skip if amount or tax is NULL
    r3_fail = (
        ~invoices["amount"].isna() & 
        ~invoices["tax"].isna() & 
        (invoices["tax"] > invoices["amount"] * 0.5)
    )
    reason_codes = [
        (codes + "|TAX_EXCESS" if codes else "TAX_EXCESS") if fail else codes
        for codes, fail in zip(reason_codes, r3_fail)
    ]
    
    # R4: due_date IS NULL -> 'DUE_NULL'
    r4_fail = invoices["due_date"].isna()
    reason_codes = [
        (codes + "|DUE_NULL" if codes else "DUE_NULL") if fail else codes
        for codes, fail in zip(reason_codes, r4_fail)
    ]
    
    # R5: customer_ref IS NULL OR TRIM(customer_ref) = '' -> 'REF_EMPTY'
    r5_fail = invoices["customer_ref"].isna() | (invoices["customer_ref"].str.strip() == "")
    reason_codes = [
        (codes + "|REF_EMPTY" if codes else "REF_EMPTY") if fail else codes
        for codes, fail in zip(reason_codes, r5_fail)
    ]
    
    # Add reason_codes column
    invoices["reason_codes"] = reason_codes
    
    # Separate clean and reject records
    invoices_clean = invoices[invoices["reason_codes"] == ""].drop(columns=["reason_codes"])
    invoices_rejects = invoices[invoices["reason_codes"] != ""]
    
    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean,
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects
    }
